diagnosis: The mortgage underwriting workflow query endpoint directly binds to workflow_id and executes the 'get_risk_evaluation' Temporal query without verifying that the workflow instance belongs to user.id or the user's lending institution. Any authenticated borrower or broker can query active underwriting workflows to extract confidential credit scores, tax filing history, and debt-to-income ratios of other applicants.
exploit_request:
GET /mortgages/workflows/wf_mortgage_app_991823/underwriting-summary HTTP/1.1
Host: workflows.homeloan-fintech.io
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_borrower_token>
